reviews.text: Thanks Anna! I'm happy with the results you've achieved with your dog. 😊 …

Martina is fantastic, I did the course with her for my little wagon that was fearful and barked at everyone, people and dogs, I learned to manage it with her advice and now I go out for walks calmly and confident in how to deal with the situations I find, thanks Martina for everything 😘😍 …

I took my puppy on a course with a dog trainer, and the experience was truly positive. We worked on all the fundamentals to help the puppy grow into a balanced adult dog: learning to do his business outside, managing anxiety when left alone, recalling, walking on a leash, the "leave it" command with objects, returning to his place, etc.

A very important aspect was also the socialization work: people, other dogs, animals, different environments, objects, and noises, to gradually acclimate him to all everyday situations.

The trainer teaches the basics and provides the right tools, but it's essential to continue working at home with consistency and patience. All the lessons were very useful and positive, and I will certainly continue with more lessons in the future to best support my dog's growth.

Martina is incredibly kind and always available! She clearly explained what we could do to improve our corgi's sociability (and reduce his aggression), and now we can take him out without him barking every time he sees a dog! We're truly delighted ❤️

Martina helped us a lot with our poodle's training and care. She's very knowledgeable, patient, and truly attentive to both the dog and the owner's needs. It was a truly positive experience; I highly recommend her!

I met Martina because I was looking for someone to teach me how to manage my dog, who had various difficult behaviors. He pulled on the leash, jumped on us, bit us, and it seemed impossible to live together. I signed up for her program, and after just over a month, things completely changed. Today, I can walk with peace of mind, I have a dog who listens to me, and I've learned to interpret his behaviors and manage them. With every lesson, I always learn new things and feel more and more confident in having the right approach with my furry friend. In addition to the lessons, Martina offers constant support every day for any questions or difficulties. I can only say THANK YOU on behalf of my entire family, and especially our Balto.

🐾Martina is unique: professional, helpful, empathetic, patient, and above all, her expertise in training furry friends online is truly unparalleled, and the results achieved are maintained and improved over time. My Amstaff puppy Pako was unmanageable, impetuous, and very lively... I wanted to build a relationship with him to experience him to the fullest. Thanks to Martina, who supported me from day one and is still available today, now that the course is over, she supports me if I have any doubts. Results were achieved from the first lessons, online, remote, but very attentive to detail. Today, Pako, having finished the course a month ago, is manageable, both indoors and outdoors, he obeys, and we live with him peacefully. He remains a puppy who wants to move and play, but with precise rules, without stress for us and especially for Pako. 🐾🐾🐾🐾
Thank you so much from me and, of course, from Pako🐶🐶🐶

I attended a masterclass with Martina, and it was a very positive experience, allowing for a fruitful exchange of experiences that greatly helped me understand canine behaviors and cues. I thank Martina for patiently listening to us and helping us overcome our difficulties with dog-friendly training methods, without coercion or punishment, but with gentle interaction and clarity of purpose.
I'm happy to give it 4 stars...we have to leave room for improvement!!! 😀
Thank you!
Thank you!

I highly recommend Martina! We needed her because our Lagotto Romagnolo puppy wasn't understanding basic commands like "come" and "kennel," and he pulled incredibly hard on the leash. We immediately noticed improvements because she taught us to "speak" his language. After several sessions, our puppy has completely changed! At the dog park, he comes when we call him, at home he brings his chew toy to his kennel (and he loves it), his behavior is better in stores and restaurants, and he's much better on the leash. We have what I call the "J"—when we walk, the leash is relaxed and forms the letter "J." Martina has always been well-prepared, patient, and has used positive reinforcement techniques. Her instructions are clear, and she provides us with practical information to continue training on our own, which we do every day. As our dog grows, we continue to contact her for additional sessions to refine his training. We are truly grateful to Martina, who is now part of our family!

My partner and I are the owners of Gin, a 7.5-kg mixed breed we adopted in 2022 when he was just 4 months old. He was found on the street and taken to a shelter in Matera. He was brought to us in the province of Milan by a relay, already very scared and unsure of everything.

Over the past year, his behavior had worsened, even becoming aggressive toward us. We then decided to consult a veterinary behaviorist, who then referred us to Martina, and we were pleasantly surprised.

In just a couple of meetings and a few weeks of dedicated work, Gin has already improved dramatically. Martina is a professional we recommend to anyone struggling with their dog: her approach is practical yet deeply empathetic. She immediately connects with the animal and is able to provide precise and easily applicable advice in everyday life, helping both dog and owner understand each other.

Thank you, Martina! 🐾
Martina is very knowledgeable and helpful. We will recommend her to friends who need better understanding of their pet's behavior.

Maria Grazia was exceptional!
She helped us understand our Milly and correct some of our mistakes.
I've always had dogs since I was little, but observing them up close with someone who understands their behavior was wonderful.
Thank you so much, from us and Milly <3!

A truly positive experience! Martina is a knowledgeable and capable professional. After just an initial consultation, aimed at correcting some of my puppy's behavioral issues, the situation immediately improved thanks to her advice and corrections!

I called Martina to help me with my two-year-old male Abruzzese Shepherd, Leo. After the loss of my partner, I found myself managing him alone and was quite desperate. The dog wouldn't let anyone in the house, and I couldn't even take him out for a vet visit. Thanks to Martina, we started a process, and week after week, we were seeing small results. It wasn't easy, but thanks to her, my parents now come into the house when I'm not there, we go for wonderful walks, and we get cuddles from people. We go to the vet, and last time we didn't even use a muzzle, I can only say: THANK YOU, MARTY!! Now there's nothing stopping us.

Martina is an excellent trainer: knowledgeable, reliable, helpful, and clear in her communication. She guided us through the training process for our Bernese Mountain Dog puppy, providing helpful advice and guidance to all of us. I highly recommend anyone considering a dog to rely on Martina's experience and professionalism. Thank you for everything from us and Tokyo!

Super nice and helpful trainer.
It was my first experience with a puppy with a very strong personality; she helped me manage him in a very short time with the help of various exercises.

Martina has guided us on a truly rewarding journey with our dachshund: we've learned to get to know each other and recognize his cues. It's not always easy, but thanks to her teaching, we've managed to overcome initially difficult situations. It takes patience, but I couldn't be more satisfied! I highly recommend everyone to embark on a journey with a trainer, and above all, I thank Martina for her dedication and precision in the techniques we've covered.

A truly educational experience!
I chose the puppy program for my dog ​​with Martina, and I must say I gained so many skills to help me raise my Flora to the fullest!
Highly recommended!

Martina was incredibly helpful in helping me train my Water Dog puppy. She was always available to offer advice in emergencies and gave me simple instructions on how to handle the more complicated aspects of caring for a puppy.
I highly recommend using Martina's service, especially the 10-lesson package, which is perfectly priced. I will definitely contact her again if I need it.
We did the introductory truffle hunting course with Martina. It was a truly wonderful experience, interesting and stimulating for both dog and owner.
Martina is a very empathetic and knowledgeable professional. She has provided us with great support in training our dachshunds. We recommend her to anyone looking for a truly competent trainer.

Martina is a super professional! We quickly managed to correct my toy poodle's behavior. Lessons with her are enjoyable and practical, with everything explained very well, including homework assignments.
I highly recommend her!

We entrusted ourselves to Martina in March because Obi was clearly having problems managing separation anxiety.
She taught us how to work with our dog, and with a lot of patience (hers 😂) and daily exercises, we finally changed Obi's behavior.
Thank you for your expertise and availability... and above all for solving a problem that seemed impossible to solve.

I had a major problem with my Border Collie: anything that moved was an irresistible stimulus for her. Scooters, bikes, running children… it didn't take long for her to take off, and I couldn't control her anymore. Every outing was a source of stress, and I lived with the anxiety that something unpleasant might happen.

I turned to Martina for behavioral rehabilitation, and from the first few meetings, I knew I'd made the right choice. She patiently guided me step by step, explaining not only what to do but also why we were doing it. The work wasn't immediate, but seeing my dog's tangible progress gave me the motivation to continue.

Today, the situation is completely different: my Border Collie manages to stay calm even when bicycles or playing children pass by, and she has finally become the calm and reliable companion I dreamed of. I can honestly say that our life together has changed for the better, and every walk is now a pleasure.

A huge thank you to Martina for her professionalism, patience, and above all, the love she puts into her work.

Martina was incredibly helpful in teaching us how to manage our Appenzell Mountain Dog, which has very severe behavioral issues. We visited several schools and trainers before finding Martina, whom we wish we had found sooner, as she was the only one who truly made a difference for us and our dog. The lessons helped us greatly with leash walking and the social situations we were having the most difficulty with. Martina is excellent at what she does; you can tell she has a wealth of experience with challenging dogs and she also has a very humane approach; she also considers the impact the dog has on its environment on a psychological level, and encourages it to get involved when necessary. I would definitely recommend her!

A little less than a month ago, I adopted Sara, a 13-month-old Cocker Spaniel, and I decided to entrust her to Martina on the advice of my vet. Martina is patient, very helpful, competent, and, not surprisingly, kind. In these first few weeks, thanks to her, I've already seen some progress. We've had a truly immersive experience covering a variety of topics, including introducing her to water (highly recommended!), teaching her to swim, and teaching her to sit and stay alone, rather than play. All this with the goal of not only training the dog, but also building a bond of trust between the dog and its owner.
I recommend all owners of new and existing dogs to take at least one lesson with her!
I'll definitely be doing more lessons in September!
